item.title: Migrating JuiceFS Metadata from Redis to PGSQL
item.description: 1. Why Migrate Metadata Storage from Redis to PGSQL PGSQL is cheaper Redis stores metadata in memory, while PGSQL stores metadata on disk, so the cost difference is obvious. PGSQL performance is tunable Different PGSQL services offer different performance IOPS. If you do not have a continuously high performance requirement, PGSQL is a good choice.
